notes.title: Information about the new update, sales
notes.notes:
Hello!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/b0e761163159be59a0f8343dd29e4a3306078697.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, I didn't have internet for 2 months (in the meantime, I released a few games and updates... :D). So, there are small delays :D... But this month or next there will be a bigger update (most important):

- Disabling all powerups (if you want the game will be more racing - it cool option)
- New map (The last forest 85% completed)
- New hovercars
- New fixes for AI, paths etc.
- New championship(s)
- Fix for screens (21: 9 etc.)
- Changes to powerups etc.
- Demo update
- Fixes and other things...

Also, the game was sold almost in 1,000 units, Thank You! :D (Top countries: 1. USA, 2. Turkey, 3. Argentina :P, 4. Russia, 5. United Kingdom, 6. Poland).

notes.title: Soon new update (new maps, hovercars, options etc.)
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/a5e10ace75061813dc878c4ab2a95f767fdd7103.png[/img]

There will be a new update soon with a new map, new hovercars, options, bug fixes for AI and more. The new map is large and divided into several areas (forest only, ruined city etc.). The map is in theme summer (sun + sun rays, waterfalls, birds etc.). The map is still in development. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/55e10e693075cdd8aef1b9262a4936df2980b8bf.png[/img]

There will be small delays because unfortunately I have small personal problems (It is possible that I will not have internet 1-4 weeks :P).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/45a10b013d5bd295ccc7e00bf4c989ec5cbcd1ad.png[/img]

Thank You for any suggestions and feedback.

notes.title: The new version 1.11.25 is available for download
notes.notes:
Hello, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/e6ee94838da4bab1305930e2eaaebc09debfc0ba.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Remember that the latest update changed the game speed from 1.5 to 1.0[/u][/b], you can change it in the game settings (menu -> settings -> game options). Soon new updates and new things (championships, new options, maps, hovercars etc.).

I also think when I add FREE FLY mode, maybe I will add story mode to the game?

[b]Version 1.11.25 information: [/b]
- Sun rays/sun shafts added to tracks
- Fix for the CyberBus H9 achievement ([b][u]click on the OWN button to get the achievement[/u][/b])
- Fixes for "The desert"
- Change collision box for powerups
- Improvements for AI
- Fixes for gamepads
- Fixes for some hovercars
- New option to disable GUI (good for pro player & screenshots?)
- The last championship can be now unlocked
- Fixed some championships (No AI)
- Update for Windows 32bit, Windows 64bit, Linux 64bit and Mac 64bit
- Fixed some small bugs
- Other minor fixes

Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1793420/discussions/0/3282573132383194813/

notes.title: New update v1.11.25 coming (sun shafts/sun rays, new options, better AI etc.)
notes.notes:
Hello,

There will be a new update soon. Some maps have undergone a facelift, I added animated sun's rays:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/8baa3ed067f2f593e74d493197c8ce406638646d.png[/img]

Animated rays are efficient,  they will not affect the performance. They are made by a simple method. The sun's rays have been added, because they will appear on the new map. About new map: "The last forest" map will also be available soon for free (summer post-apocalyptic edition - perfect for today's times 2022...). It's a large map and has been split into several tracks (Total forest, ruined city -  You can fly into ruined buildings and temples etc.).

notes.title: New demo version is available (v1.1)
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/f472a036bbbb6c98192ff681f1be5c4057aacbe0.png[/img]

New demo version is available (v1.1).  The demo is limited (tracks, championships, hovercars etc.) but includes all options (You can change FOV, game speed etc.). To download the demo, you must click the green DOWNLOAD button on the product page.

notes.title: A new version is available on Steam (v1.10.24)
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/7b280594518079e290bb50a89cfef626b1714417.jpg[/img]

For now, I am focusing on fixes, adding options etc, later I will add more new hovercars, maps, championships. A new version is available:

- 2 new hovercars one from Japan Yakuza XII (new generation) and the other from Korea [spoiler]Legendary car[/spoiler]
- Gamepad vibration 
- Changing the speed from 1.5 to 1.0 (if the game is too slow you can change it in Menu -> Settings -> Game Options -> Game speed 1.0-2.0)
- Key (re)mapping fixes (keyboard/gamepad)
- Controls fixes (keyboard / gamepad)
- Performance improvements (low end / high end)
- Fixes for some maps (more coming in next update)
- The default gamepad controls have been changed
- Full version upgrade: Windows 32bit, Windows 64bit, Linux 64bit, Mac 64bit
- Demo update: Windows 32bit, Windows 64bit, Linux 64bit, Mac 64bit*
- Other minor fixes

[u][b]* Demo will be soon updated (I making new)[/b][/u]
** Game speed was changed for new players (You can change it in settings -> game options)

New updates coming soon.

notes.title: New version coming (version 1.10.24)
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424346/f472a036bbbb6c98192ff681f1be5c4057aacbe0.png[/img]

I'm just testing a new update. If there are no problems with the new update, I will update the game and demo on Friday or Saturday.

New update will make some changes:
- Game speed from 1.5 to 1.0
- New Hovercars
- Fixed control configuration (gamepad/keyboard)
- New options
- And more...

If the game is too fast/difficult remember that you can change it in the options (settings -> game options), You can also change FOV, invert y-axis etc.
